name: prayer_of_binding_exiled_permanent_returns_when_it_leaves
notes: M4 mapper. Printed: 'When this enchantment enters, exile up to one target nonland permanent an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield. You gain 2 life.' Seat 0 casts Prayer of Binding and its trigger exiles seat 1's Opp Ogre; seat 0 gains 2 life. Then another effect puts the Prayer into its owner's graveyard: the Ogre returns to the battlefield under its owner's control (CR 610.3), and the 2 life stays.
